Problem Statement
Given an array of integers, find the largest element and the position of its first occurrence using a linear scan.
Description
Read an array of integers and traverse it once from left to right. Find the largest value in the array and print the largest value along with the 0-based index of its first occurrence.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers.
Output Description
Print the largest value and its first 0-based index in the format: `Largest: X` and `Index: Y`.
Sample Input
6
15 8 27 12 27 20
Sample Output
Largest: 27
Index: 2
